evidence: Gate dimensions carry the real gate: gates/render/judge.toml (all_pass) requires / to load with a code editing area and reload again; gates/constraints/judge.toml (all_pass) adds the backing leg cw_shared_saved_record (save via the app, clear all origin storage, reload, exact title/filename/source readback, second reload), which zeros blank, static-shell and localStorage-only apps, plus the brief-backed custom-surface leg (ui.md line 3). scoring.toml gates render=0.0/constraints=0.0 with score.py line 41-48 (gate score must exceed 0, else reward 0) and test.sh lines 213-221 (scored suite never runs unless gates pass) make the gate a true hard zero carrying no reward mass. Each scored prompt (functional line 5, polish line 5, visual line 5) restates the in-dimension gate ('loads from http://localhost:3000 without a fatal browser error and shows the workspace with a code editing area ... If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion'), matching the template's shape; the app has no sign-in (app_context 'Accounts: None'), so no auth leg is needed; visual line 9 preserves the hard zero ('Apart from a failed global browser gate'). No prompt or gate requires same-origin: render/constraints/scored prompts all say external font/script/CDN requests are allowed, app_context line 34 allows public network access, and the backing leg is defined by storage-cleared readback, not by origin; the only origin-related demands are the preview-isolation criterion (a public security.md requirement, scored, not a gate). Counter-probes: a static shell with a fake div editor passes render and the in-dimension wording but fails constraints persistence, so it is zeroed by the gate suite; a conforming canvas/SVG editor or one with a hidden key-catching input, or one backed by any server, passes. Residual risk (reason risk=true): no configured-judge run exists on these v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says hosted runs are v15 only), and no static-shell or localStorage-only mutant has been run through the gates, so actual gate execution is unmeasured; the scored in-dimension gate wording itself would not exclude a static shell on its own and relies on the gate suite sequencing.
